stem: Leaf-edge stress appears only on plants nearest one supply-air path while root-zone measurements and irrigation records remain comparable to unaffected plants. Which evidence should be prioritized next?
choices: Spatial temperature, humidity, and airflow measurements across the affected and unaffected canopy
The total harvest from the previous cycle
rationale: A spatial symptom pattern aligned with an air path makes local environmental distribution evidence more discriminating than a facility-wide input change.
